title: Does NOT Fit Instant Pot Liner, Cuisinart Saucepan
text:
Does NOT Fit Instant Pot Liner, Cuisinart Saucepan. This KITCHEN GIZMO SNAP N STRAIN STRAINER (Fits all Pots and Bowls; Lime Green) does NOT fit my Cuisinart saucepans or my Instant Pot stainless steel liner. The claim that it “fits all pots and bowls” is incorrect. The problem is that the strainer is pre-formed to a certain curve, so that it leaves a big gap at the bottom between the strainer and the saucepan/pot edge if the strainer and pan curves don’t exactly match. This means that the pan contents slide right out through the gap when you try to strain off grease or water.

I purchased this item in hopes of using it to strain grease from my Instant Pot. However, it doesn’t come close to matching the curve of the Instant Pot liner, so it is useless for this purpose. It is also useless for straining water off pasta cooked in a Cuisinart saucepan, because the curves don’t match. The clips are clumsy to use, especially if you are trying to clip the Gizmo onto a hot pan.

In short, the Gizmo doesn’t work nearly as well as [[ASIN:B0021Y9O1O an inexpensive plastic colander]] for straining veggies, pasta, or anything else cooked in boiling water.
